# Investeraren: Traditionell aktieanalys har förlorat sitt värde

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-15  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Robert Aldin, chairman and founder of the investment company Edastra, talks about his book 'Darwin och aktiemarknaden'. His argument is that AI makes intelligence free and traditional analysis loses its edge, which leaves discipline, self-insight and judgement as the investor's advantage. He warns against adjusted EBITDA as 'financial theatre' and prefers earnings per share and cash flow. He also covers Edastra's long-held stakes (Truecaller, MSAB, CombinedX) and argues that AI winners such as Anthropic are pulling ahead of OpenAI, while noting there are almost no listed AI companies in Sweden.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 TRUE-B — Truecaller | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest (an owner via Edastra) says the turnaround is working: the stock is up nearly 100% since June, confidence is partly restored and the CEO stayed.

#### Reasoning

The guest's Edastra is a long-term Truecaller owner. After falling on lost profitability and short attacks, the business has been turned around, the stock has almost doubled since June and management is taking 'nya steg för framtiden'. The guest is clearly positive but gives no explicit buy call, and as a holder he is biased.

#### Sell Triggers

- if profitability deteriorates again
- if renewed short attacks meet weak fundamentals
- if the company again misses early warning signs

> *"De har återfått en del av förtroendet, de har vänt på verksamheten. De tar nya steg för framtiden. Och de har inte bytt vd som Dagens Industri tyckte. Så de gör ett bra jobb tycker jag på Truecaller."*

---

### 🟡 MSAB-B — Micro Systemation (MSAB) | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Held 17 years. Board, chairman and CEO replaced in 3 years; AI is both an opportunity and a risk.

#### Reasoning

Edastra is a long-term owner that has actively restructured MSAB's governance over three years. The guest describes new AI services as both an opportunity and a threat, so his stance is mixed. It reads as continued ownership rather than a call to add.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI services erode MSAB's core forensic product
- if the new management fails to deliver the transformation

> *"I mikrosystemation, MSAB, så har vi gjort om bolaget de senaste tre åren, bytt styrelse, bytt ordförande, bytt vd. Och för dem är ju de nya AI-tjänsterna en möjlighet, men också en risk."*

---

### 🟡 CX — CombinedX | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Two units sold at good prices; the company is being reshaped into something new, which the guest calls exciting.

#### Reasoning

As a long-term owner, Edastra has crystallised value by selling two units at attractive prices and is repositioning the company. The guest is positive but gives no detail on what the new business will be.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the repositioning strategy fails
- if proceeds are poorly redeployed

> *"Combinedx är ett sådant exempel. Det är ett börsnoterat konsultföretag där vi har sålt två av rörelserna för att vi fick bra priser för dem och för att vi håller på och stöper om bolaget till någonting nytt. Det blir spännande."*

---

### 🟠 META — Meta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Named as possibly one of the few listed AI beneficiaries worth buying.

#### Reasoning

The guest wants to own companies whose margins and products improve through AI, and says that apart from possibly Meta and Alphabet there are hardly any listed AI plays. The endorsement is tentative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI investments fail to improve margins

> *"Det finns inte så mycket i USA heller, förutom möjligen Meta och Alphabet."*

---

### 🟠 GOOGL — Alphabet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Named as possibly one of the few listed AI beneficiaries worth buying.

#### Reasoning

Same reasoning as for Meta: one of the few listed companies that may benefit from AI through better margins and products, according to the guest. The endorsement is tentative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI investments fail to improve margins

> *"Det finns inte så mycket i USA heller, förutom möjligen Meta och Alphabet."*
